finding: Batch checkpoint can close the current task and immediately attempt to claim the next task before the completed task's delivery commit, causing the next claim to see the completed task's staged files as unowned or foreign WIP.
expectedBehavior: Checkpoint should expose a pending-commit state and defer next-task claim until the required delivery commit is recorded, or provide an atomic commit-window handoff.
evidenceOrRepro: Delivery f3b7692ea9ae45018d9dc4f457936f464c77cb90 adds checkpoint-commit-window-policy.ts and its focused regression. Checkpoint now records pendingCommitTaskId and a mandatory hold; resume fails closed while buildPendingCheckpointCommitWindow remains open.
followUp: Keep checkpoint-commit-window-policy.test.ts and batch-checkpoint-runner-sync-recovery.test.ts in focused validation; frozen runner publication remains a separate release step.
